title: Residential Lease and Tenancy Agreement
parties: Rajesh Sharma (Lessor) and Amit Verma (Lessee)
summary_text: A 11-month residential tenancy agreement for property in Bangalore with monthly rent of INR 45,000, 5% annual escalation, 2 months lock-in period, and INR 2.5 Lakhs refundable security deposit.
full_text:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AND TENANCY AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 15th June 2024 between Rajesh Sharma (Lessor) and Amit Verma (Lessee).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 45,000 per month (Deposit INR 2,50,000).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. RENT AND DEPOSIT:
The Lessee shall pay a monthly rent of INR 45,000 payable on or before 5th of each English calendar month, along with an interest-free refundable security deposit of INR 2,50,000.

CLAUSE 2. ESCALATION CLAUSE:
Upon completion of 11 months, if renewed by mutual consent, the monthly rent shall automatically increase by 10% per annum.

CLAUSE 3. UNILATERAL TERMINATION & FORFEITURE:
Lessor reserves unconditional right to terminate tenancy with 7 days notice without cause and forfeit 50% deposit if premise is vacated before lock-in.

CLAUSE 4. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS:
Lessee shall bear all internal minor repair costs up to INR 2,000 while major structural repairs remain Lessor's responsibility under Transfer of Property Act.

CLAUSE 5. INDEMNIFICATION:
Lessee agrees to unconditionally indemnify and hold Lessor harmless against any structural damages, neighbor disputes, or municipal violations arising during occupancy.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

COMMERCIAL LEASE DEED WITH RESTRICTIVE LOCK-IN

THIS AGREEMENT made on 01st April 2024 between Prime Spaces Pvt Ltd (Lessor) and Zenith Tech Solutions (Lessee).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 3,50,000 per month (Deposit INR 21,00,000).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. LOCK-IN PERIOD:
The Lessee shall strictly adhere to a mandatory 36-month non-terminable lock-in period. If Lessee vacates early, Lessee is liable to pay the entire remaining rent for the balance period.

CLAUSE 2. UNLIMITED INDEMNITY:
Lessee shall hold Lessor harmless and provide unlimited indemnification against all regulatory penalties, employee actions, or property losses regardless of fault.

CLAUSE 3. DISPUTE RESOLUTION:
All disputes shall be referred to a sole arbitrator unilaterally appointed by the Lessor, with seat of arbitration exclusively in New Delhi.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. VEHICLE PARTICULARS & CONSIDERATION:
Seller transfers Hyundai Creta 2021 model (Chassis: ME1234, Engine: EN9876) for agreed consideration of INR 6,75,000 received in full.

Buyer covenants to submit Form 29, 30, and 28 (NOC) to Regional Transport Office (RTO) within 14 days and transfer Registration Certificate.

CLAUSE 3. ACCIDENT & TRAFFIC CHALLAN INDEMNITY:
From the exact date and hour of physical delivery (05-May-2024, 14:00 hrs), Buyer assumes full civil, criminal, and motor accident tribunal (MACT) liabilities.

CLAUSE 4. WARRANTY DISCLAIMER (AS-IS WHERE-IS):
Vehicle is sold on strictly 'As-Is-Where-Is' basis with no express or implied warranty on mechanical or electrical condition.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

summary_text: Vehicle hypothecation agreement granting lender first charge on car, authority to repossess vehicle without prior court intervention on 30-day EMI default, and 24% bounce charges.
full_text:
AUTO LOAN HYPOTHECATION & VEHICLE SECURITY AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 18th November 2023 between HDFC Bank Ltd (Lender) and Manoj Pillai (Borrower).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 9,50,000 (Sanctioned at 8.75% p.a.).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. HYPOTHECATION & FIRST CHARGE:
Borrower creates exclusive first hypothecation charge over Tata Harrier SUV in favor of Bank, endorsed on RTO RC book under Motor Vehicles Act.

CLAUSE 2. UNILATERAL REPOSSESSION CLAUSE:
Upon default in payment of two consecutive EMIs, Bank shall have unfettered right to repossess the vehicle without court intervention or prior notice.

CLAUSE 3. PREPAYMENT PENALTY:
Prepayment or foreclosure within first 12 months is subject to 5% foreclosure fee plus applicable GST on outstanding principal balance.

CLAUSE 4. DEFAULT INTEREST & CHEQUE BOUNCE:
Delayed EMI attracts overdue penal interest of 24% per annum compounded monthly plus INR 750 bounce charges per dishonored NACH mandate.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

THIS AGREEMENT made on 14th March 2024 between State Bank of India (Lender) and Raghavendra Enterprises (Borrower).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. SANCTION AND DISBURSEMENT:
Bank sanctions term loan of INR 50,00,000 repayable in 60 equated monthly installments with interest reset on quarterly basis linked to RBI Repo Rate.

CLAUSE 2. CROSS-DEFAULT AND ACCELERATION:
Any default by Borrower or its directors in any other credit facility across any financial institution triggers instant acceleration and total recall of this loan.

CLAUSE 3. SARFAESI ENFORCEMENT & ASSET ATTACHMENT:

CLAUSE 4. MATERIAL ADVERSE CHANGE (MAC):
Bank reserves right to demand immediate full repayment if in Bank's sole judgment any material adverse change occurs in Borrower's financial health.

CLAUSE 5. PERSONAL GUARANTEE OF DIRECTORS:
Managing Director executes unconditional, irrevocable, joint and several continuing personal guarantee covering all dues and enforcement expenses.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.

GOLD JEWELLERY PLEDGE AND LOAN AGREEMENT

THIS AGREEMENT made on 19th April 2024 between Muthoot Finance Ltd (Lender) and K. Narayana Swamy (Borrower).

WHEREAS the consideration / facility amount involved is INR 3,20,000 (Gross Wt: 85g, Net Wt: 72g 22-Karat).

NOW THIS DEED WITNESSETH AS FOLLOWS:

CLAUSE 1. PLEDGE OF ORNAMENTS & PURITY APPRAISAL:
Borrower pledges 72 grams net 22-Karat gold ornaments appraised and sealed in tamper-proof pouch in Borrower's presence.

CLAUSE 2. MARGIN CALL & MARKET FLUCTUATION:
If market price of gold drops and Loan-to-Value (LTV) exceeds 75% as per RBI guidelines, Borrower must pay margin money within 14 days of notice.

CLAUSE 3. PUBLIC AUCTION & RECOVERY:
Upon failure to redeem within 12 months or failure to meet margin call, Lender possesses unconditional right to sell gold via public auction to recover principal and penal interest.

CLAUSE 4. SAFE CUSTODY & INDEMNITY:
Lender's liability for pledged gold in case of burglary or fire is strictly limited to standard insurance settlement value, excluding emotional or antique worth.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed on the date mentioned above.
